explanation.text: The original post is a lighthearted #caturday meme featuring a cat and a sign that jokes, “IF CATS COULD TEXT YOU BACK THEY WOULD NOT,” playing on the stereotype of cats being aloof and indifferent to humans.

The meme’s caption and the account name “Irrefutable proof cats are evil” frame the joke as if cats intentionally ignore people, exaggerating normal cat behavior (independence and selective attention) for comedic effect rather than making a serious claim about cats.

Replies in the thread extend the joke by imagining how cats would behave if they could use phones—for example, only sending photos of empty food bowls, demanding breakfast by text, or questioning why someone is texting cats—reinforcing the humorous idea that cats would focus solely on their own needs.

The “Correct.” reply in the thread affirms the meme’s punchline that cats would not text back, showing other users are engaging with and endorsing the playful portrayal of cats as unresponsive and self-centered.
